latest_release.name: v2.31.0
latest_release.body:
## 主要更新

- API Token 可限制在指定笔记本及其子笔记本内，并设为只读或读写。现有 Token 保留原有权限。
- 支持导入单个 Markdown 文件或整个目录。目录导入保留子目录层级，并解析本地附件和笔记间链接。
- 多维表格支持保存带筛选和多字段排序的命名视图，大表格滚动更流畅，链接字段可直接点击打开。
- 修复移动浏览器中无法选择 Joplin .jex 文件的问题，并避免 Evernote 任务标题和日期混入导入后的笔记正文。
- 更新 EdgeEver 标志、应用图标和 Demo 示例笔记，并调整合并笔记的分隔线。
- 减少重复同步和插件请求，重新部署到 Cloudflare 时默认保留正在生效的登录配置。

关联 Issue：#870, #837, #849, #851, #853

## Key Changes

- Restrict API tokens to selected notebooks and their sub-notebooks, with read-only or read/write access. Existing tokens retain their access.
- Import individual Markdown files or folders. Folder imports preserve subfolders and resolve local attachments and links between notes.
- Save named views with filters and multi-column sorting in structured tables, scroll large tables more smoothly, and open URLs directly from link cells.
- Fix selecting Joplin .jex files in mobile browsers and prevent Evernote task titles and dates from appearing in imported note text.
- Refresh the EdgeEver logo and app icons, update the Demo example notes, and refine separators in merged notes.
- Reduce redundant sync and plugin requests, and preserve active authentication settings by default when redeploying to Cloudflare.

Related Issue: #870, #837, #849, #851, #853

贡献者 / Contributors：@xinyang920 @sivdead @jayhemnani9910

detail.readme:
EdgeEver

AI-native note-taking app & Evernote/Obsidian alternative. Instant all-platform sync, rich notes (tables, mind maps, diagrams, posters), web clipper & MCP. 100% free on Cloudflare or Docker.

简体中文 | 繁體中文 | English | Español | Deutsch | Français | 日本語 | Polski | Русский

Telegram Group  |  🌐 Live Demo  |  🗺️ Roadmap  |  📱 Clients & Extension  |  Feature Matrix & Capabilities  |  📥 Note Migration

EdgeEver is a modern, open-source notes and knowledge base workspace. It preserves the classic, high-efficiency three-pane productivity workflow (Tree View · Note List · Editor) while offering an open data architecture and seamless AI Agent integration for complete ownership and smart productivity. > 💡 **Serverless & 100% Free Forever** > EdgeEver can run within Cloudflare's free quotas with no server purchase or VPS maintenance. Users who prefer a VPS, NAS, or home server can deploy the same application with Docker. > ⭐ If EdgeEver is useful to you, consider giving it a Star. Your support helps more people discover the project. ## Why EdgeEver Many users of **note-taking apps and personal knowledge bases** simply want a **reliable, open, and fast** personal knowledge base. However, existing mainstream solutions all present tradeoffs: * **Evernote**: Offers the smoothest, most seamless multi-device cloud sync experience. Yet as it evolved into a full-featured commercial suite, ads and add-ons multiplied while system overhead climbed. Meanwhile, free-tier quotas tightened, premium AI subscriptions grew expensive, and it remains difficult to integrate into modern self-hosted and private AI workflows. * **Obsidian**: Open Markdown files, closed-source core. Official Sync requires an ongoing subscription tiered by storage and vault count, while third-party sync (iCloud, WebDAV, Git, etc.) is tedious and conflict-prone; constrained by local-directory file sync and mobile background limits, it struggles to match the seamless, invisible sync of cloud-native note apps (and lacks a full web workspace). Relying on local file scanning causes noticeable cold-start and search lag once notes reach the thousands or plugins pile up; storing attachments alongside notes bloats vaults, slows mobile sync, and leaves orphaned files behind. Combined with an IDE-like UI and plugin-tinkering learning curve, it feels overly heavy for users used to out-of-the-box, capture-anywhere cloud note apps. * **Joplin**: A veteran open-source three-pane note app, yet its UI design and editing experience feel stuck more than a decade in the past, lacking modern polish and fluidity. Fast official sync (Joplin Cloud) requires a paid subscription; free sync via WebDAV or cloud drives relies on file-by-file polling that becomes sluggish on mobile as notes and attachments grow, while self-hosting Joplin Server requires maintaining your own server with no zero-cost serverless option. It also lacks a full browser-based web workspace and native AI Agent capabilities (MCP/ACP). * **Memos & Stream Notes**: Clean and simple, but their social-timeline layouts differ fundamentally from the structured productivity of a classic three-pane workflow. * **SiYuan & Block-based PKMs**: Powerful with self-hosting support, but their UI and interaction feel closer to heavy Obsidian-style PKMs than the intuitive three-pane experience of traditional commercial cloud note apps, and their granular "block-level" architecture also imposes noticeable cognitive overhead for quick daily capture and continuous prose writing. Furthermore, they lack a true zero-cost serverless deployment tier, and multi-device sync relies on paid official subscriptions or paying extra to unlock S3/WebDAV sync features with your own storage. **EdgeEver fills this gap**: The entire stack is open source, delivering truly **seamless, low-latency, instant multi-device cloud sync** with full self-hosting freedom. It keeps the three-pane layout you know, stays silky-smooth and lightweight even with 10,000+ notes, and ships native AI agents with zero-cost deployment. ## Online Demo - Demo: [https://demo.edgeever.org](https://demo.edgeever.org) The public demo resets every day at 3:00 AM (China Standard Time) and restores sample notes. Do not store private content there. ## All-Platform Clients & Browser Extension ### Client Downloads

           

> The iOS app requires an Apple ID from outside mainland China. ### Browser Web Clipper Extension

     

- Extract clean Markdown from web articles or clip selected text and images directly to your self-hosted instance. - Deep structured clipping for 20+ platforms: social (X, Xiaohongshu, WeChat, Jike, Douban, Threads, Bluesky), dev & reading communities (Zhihu, Reddit, GitHub, V2EX, Hacker News, Medium, Substack), and media/podcasts (Bilibili, YouTube, Xiaoyuzhou). ## Feature Matrix & Capabilities An all-in-one workspace connecting inspiration capture, deep creation, and knowledge compounding (👉 **[Explore 20 step-by-step showcases with screenshots](docs/best-practices.md)**): | Module | Core Features | Advanced Features | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Writing & Editing** | • Classic 3-pane layout with resizable panel width
• Seamless toggle between rich-text WYSIWYG & raw Markdown
• Syntax highlighting, math formulas, task lists & Focus Mode
• Second-level auto-save, instant multi-device sync & revision history | • **Native Poster Notes**: Canvas-based structured visual card layouts, double-click to edit
• **WeChat Official Account Formatter**: One-click copy with inline CSS to newsletters/blogs
• **Poster Image Export**: Curated themes, Monogram avatars; export to MD, HTML, or PDF
• **Desktop Productivity Tools**: Global shortcut screen-region capture to notes, automatic writeback for externally edited attachments, and multi-window note editing | | **Organization & Search** | • Infinite-depth notebooks & folder tree navigation
• Tagging system, drag-and-drop sorting, batch note merging/moving
• Millisecond-level full-text search with historical filtering | • **Standalone Knowledge Base Publishing**: One-click publish entire notebooks as static documentation sites with tree navigation & password protection
• **One-Click Third-Party Migration**: Native GUI import for flomo, Evernote, Obsidian, and Joplin with full notes, hierarchies, and attachments
• Multi-user spaces & physical tenant data isolation | | **Capture & Media** | • Universal attachment uploads (PDF, Office, audio/video, archives)
• Browser extension precision clipping for web text & images
• Mobile system share sheet to save photos & articles | • **Deep Multi-Platform Structured Clipping**: Deeply adapted for Xiaohongshu, X (Twitter), Zhihu, Reddit, GitHub, YouTube, Bilibili, and 20+ sources
• **WeChat Chat History Archiving**: One-click full transcript import with timestamps, quotes, emojis, and media
• **Client-Side Image Compression**: Automatic 50%–90% silent size reduction; chunked streaming safely supports up to 1 GiB files
• **OSS Object Storage & Desktop Image Hosting**: S3-compatible object storage per instance; direct desktop uploads via PicGo / PicList and CloudFlare ImgBed | | **Data & Visuals** | • Native table editing & Markdown table rendering
• Native Mermaid diagrams (flowcharts, sequence diagrams, architecture) | • **AI Multi-Dimensional Tables**: Prompt-to-database with automatic field typing (tags, dates, selects)
• **Public Online Collection Forms**: One-click shareable forms without login, syncing responses into tables in real time
• **AI Diagram & Infographic Generation**: In-place creation of timelines, comparison charts, quadrant matrices & mind maps | | **AI & Ecosystem** | • Companion sidebar AI assistant for summaries, proofreading & translations
• BYOK (Bring Your Own Key): compatible with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini & custom endpoints | • **Native Agent Protocols (MCP & ACP)**: Built-in MCP for external agent read/write; ACP in desktop app to drive local agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity and WorkBuddy directly
• **AI Audio & Video Transcription**: Client-side audio extraction and chunking, connecting directly to OpenAI-compatible speech models to transcribe and insert text into notes
• **Open Plugin API & Theme Ecosystem**: One-click install from marketplace or GitHub with cross-device sync; supports reading/writing notes and editor interactions, custom panels and commands, AI invocation, desktop scheduled tasks, and codeless theme customization | | **Multi-Device Sync & Foundation** | • Seamless, low-latency sync across desktop, mobile, and web with zero device limits
• Official client support across Web, macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android
• Offline-first with auto-sync queue: write smoothly offline, automatically resume and sync when reconnected
• Standard SQLite database, lossless ZIP backup & Markdown export/import | • **Zero Server Cost for Life**: 100% runnable on Cloudflare Free tier (~150k short notes & ~50k images)
• **Flexible Docker Self-Hosting**: One-click deployment for VPS, NAS, or home server with millions of notes & instant sync
• **Desktop Auto-Backup**: Scheduled local backups with multi-snapshot retention, optional password encryption, and automatic WebDAV off-site copies
• Server-side brute-force protection, TOTP two-factor authentication (2FA), active device session management, and tenant isolation | ## Deployment Cloudflare is the recommended zero-server deployment. Docker is available for users who prefer a VPS, NAS, or home server. For Cloudflare, choose either of the following online deployment options: ### Option A: Deploy with an AI Agent (Recommended) Copy the prompt below directly into an AI Agent (such as Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, etc.). During execution, if access to GitHub or Cloudflare is required, review the requested permissions and follow the prompts to authorize access. ```text Deploy EdgeEver entirely through GitHub and Cloudflare: 1. Fork https://github.com/tianma-if/edgeever. 2. Create D1 `edgeever` and R2 `edgeever-resources` in Cloudflare. 3. In Workers & Pages, select "Start with Hello World!" and create a Worker named `edgeever`. 4. Add the user's chosen password as the runtime Secret `EDGE_EVER_AUTH_PASSWORD` under Settings → Variables and Secrets, and deploy the Secret (preferably at least 32 characters). The username defaults to `admin`. 5. Only after the Secret is deployed, open this Worker's Settings → Builds → Connect and connect the Fork's `main` branch. 6. In this Worker's Settings → Builds → API token, select or create the Cloudflare API token used for deployment, with D1 read/edit permission for the target account. 7. In the Fork's GitHub repository, open Actions → Update deployed EdgeEver, enable the workflow if prompted, and select Run workflow on `main`. After confirming in Cloudflare that the corresponding build succeeded and deployment completed, verify `/api/health` and `/api/openapi.json`, then log in with the administrator username and password. This workflow will automatically sync future stable releases and fixes. ``` > Detailed requirements: [AI Agent Cloudflare Deployment](docs/agent-deploy-cloudflare.md). ### Option B: Manual Online Deployment
📖 Click to expand: 7-Step Web Manual Deployment Guide Complete the following 7 web steps strictly in order: 1. **Fork the Repository**: Click **Fork** at the top right of GitHub to fork EdgeEver into your personal account. 2. **Create Cloudflare Resources**: Create D1 `edgeever` and R2 `edgeever-resources`. 3. **Create the Worker**: In Cloudflare Workers & Pages, select Create application → Start with Hello World!, name the Worker `edgeever`, and deploy it. This creates a placeholder; EdgeEver is deployed in Step 7. 4. **Set the Administrator Password**: Under the Worker’s Settings → Variables and Secrets, add `EDGE_EVER_AUTH_PASSWORD` as type Secret and click Deploy. Its value is your chosen login password, preferably at least 32 characters. Complete this before connecting the Fork. 5. **Connect the Fork**: In the existing Worker’s Settings → Builds → Connect, select the Fork and production branch `main`. 6. **Configure Deployment Permissions**: In this Worker's Settings → Builds → API token, select or create the Cloudflare API token used for deployment, with D1 read/edit permission for the target account. 7. **Build & Verify**: In the Fork's GitHub repository, open Actions → Update deployed EdgeEver, enable the workflow if prompted, and select Run workflow on `main`. After confirming in Cloudflare that the corresponding build succeeded and deployment completed, confirm `/api/health` returns `200` and verify login. This workflow will automatically sync future stable releases and fixes. > 📖 For full step-by-step instructions and configuration details, see the [Online Deployment Guide](docs/deploy-cloudflare-button.md).
📌 View Cloudflare Deployment Notes (Custom Domain & Free R2 Allowance) > **Custom Domain & Access**: After deployment, you can directly use the default `*.workers.dev` domain assigned by Cloudflare, or attach your own custom domain in the Worker settings under **Settings → Domains & Routes**. > > **Cloudflare R2 Activation**: Although Cloudflare R2 offers a generous [free storage allowance](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/#free-tier) that note-taking workloads remain completely within, you must first activate an R2 subscription and add a payment method. Cloudflare [officially supports](https://developers.cloudflare.com/billing/get-started/update-billing-info/#supported-payment-methods) UnionPay, Visa, Mastercard, and other cards, as well as PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and other payment methods.
### Option C: Docker on a VPS or NAS Docker runs the same frontend, API routes, services, authentication, MCP implementation, and migrations as Cloudflare. The container uses SQLite with local files or S3-compatible attachment storage and supports `amd64` and `arm64`. See [Deploy EdgeEver with Docker](docs/deploy-docker.md) and [Self-hosting and Docker architecture](docs/self-hosting-architecture.md). Use the GitHub-hosted installer and the official GHCR image: ```sh curl -fsSL https://edgeever.org/install.sh | bash ``` The command pulls the latest image, generates an administrator password, and starts EdgeEver with Docker Compose. See the [Docker deployment guide](docs/deploy-docker.md) for manual deployment and configuration. After installation, updates run automatically each day by default. To update manually, run `~/edgeever/update.sh` on the deployment server. --- ## Advanced Configuration & Management ### Data Backup, Export & Migration Whether for routine data backups, seamless cross-instance migration, or switching from existing note platforms, EdgeEver provides reliable, complete data mobility: - **EdgeEver Native Backup & Restore**: In the app, go to **Profile** -> **Import and export** to export or import an EdgeEver ZIP archive at any time. The extracted `notes/` directory keeps clean plaintext Markdown files and attachments for local archival or direct reading, while internal structured metadata enables lossless full restoration across different EdgeEver instances. Importing preserves existing unrelated data on the target instance and automatically overwrites records with matching IDs. - **Desktop Scheduled Auto-Backup & Off-Site Copy**: Under **Backup & Import** in the desktop app, you can enable scheduled local backups (weekly or monthly) with a custom folder, snapshot retention count, and automatic creation of standard ZIP or encrypted `.edgeever.enc` archives whenever content changes, plus automatic WebDAV uploads to a NAS or compatible storage after each local backup. - **Smooth Migration from Third-Party Apps**: Whether importing via the native one-click GUI (supporting complete notes, hierarchies, and attachments from Evernote, Obsidian, and Joplin) or migrating from Notion, flomo, Memos, and other platforms via AI Agent & MCP, EdgeEver provides seamless, verified data mobility. See the [Third-Party Notes Migration Guide](docs/note-migration-guide.en-US.md). ### AI & MCP Protocol Integration Create an API token in **Profile** -> **API / MCP** and copy the Remote MCP configuration in one click to let AI Agents such as Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and Antigravity securely manage your knowledge base within account permissions. EdgeEver supports full CRUD for text notes, visual diagram notes (mind maps, flowcharts, and architecture diagrams), structured table notes, and native poster notes. Agents can also manage notebook hierarchies, tags, attachments, revision history, note templates, and AI instructions. For client setup, token access levels, troubleshooting and suggested rules for agents, see [Using EdgeEver with MCP clients](docs/mcp-guide.md). > 💡 **Inspiration:** > Make AI your true knowledge orchestrator and creative co-pilot—instantly turn concepts into interactive mind maps, flowcharts, architecture diagrams, and structured tables, while supplying private context to your AI Agents. Paired with EdgeEver’s powerful rich-text editing and elegant typography, AI-assisted content becomes beautifully structured, polished, and publication-ready knowledge assets. ### Multi-Account Login & Storage Management Once deployed, a single instance supports multi-account login. The instance administrator can create, disable, or reset member accounts in **Profile** -> **User accounts**. Each member gets a fully isolated personal workspace, including notebooks, notes, attachments, Trash, import/export, and MCP tokens. An intuitive storage usage dashboard provides real-time visibility into attachment storage consumed across the whole instance as well as per account. ### Storage Extension & Third-Party Image Hosting - **OSS Object Storage**: The instance owner can configure S3-compatible object storage under **Settings → Advanced → OSS object storage**. Changing storage does not migrate or affect existing attachments. - **Desktop PicGo integration**: The desktop app can hand inserted images to a PicGo or PicList server on this computer or on another machine you trust, such as a NAS. That server uploads them to GitHub, SM.MS, Upyun, Qiniu, or a custom image host. The address only needs to end with `/upload`, so a PicList behind a reverse proxy works too. - **CloudFlare ImgBed on desktop and web**: Upload inserted images directly to your self-hosted [CloudFlare ImgBed](https://github.com/MarSeventh/CloudFlare-ImgBed) using an API token. Folder templates support `{Y}/{m}/{d}` and `{memoId}`. Web access requires HTTPS and CORS allowing your EdgeEver origin and the `Authorization` header. Credentials stay in the current browser or desktop app; images are excluded from EdgeEver backups. ### Plugins and Themes Web and desktop apps support functional plugins and custom themes, installable from the official marketplace, GitHub, or a Manifest URL, with seamless sync across your workspace. Developers can extend capabilities using `@edgeever/plugin-api`; see the [plugin development guide](docs/plugin-development.md) and [marketplace submission policy](docs/plugin-marketplace-policy.md). --- ## Developer Guide & Contributing ### Quick Start ```sh bun install bun run dev ``` Local development signs in automatically; fresh databases use `owner` / `edgeever-local-dev`. Log out to test the login screen. ### Architecture & Tech Stack #### Tech Stack - Bun workspace monorepo with Web, API, official site, and shared type package. - Frontend: Vite, React, React Router, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and Radix UI. - Editor: TipTap / ProseMirror with Markdown support. - Android app: Expo + React Native in `apps/mobile`, with SQLite local storage and incremental sync. - iOS app: Native SwiftUI in `apps/ios` (iOS 17+), with a packaged TipTap EditorBundle, GRDB local mirror/outbox, and Android-aligned shell chrome. - Native desktop app: Electron + Rust sidecar combines a consistent cross-platform experience with high-performance local data services; SQLite enables offline editing, incremental sync when back online, and local backups. - Web clipper: Manifest V3, Mozilla Readability, and Turndown for Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox. - Backend: one Hono/Zod business application with REST API and Remote MCP; Cloudflare uses Workers/D1/R2, while Docker uses Bun/SQLite/local files or S3. - Official site: Astro static site in `apps/site`, deployable to Cloudflare Pages. #### Project Structure
📁 Expand to view: Monorepo Project Structure ```text apps/web Vite + React frontend, offline drafts, and sync queue apps/extension Chrome/Edge/Firefox Manifest V3 web clipper apps/api Cloudflare Worker + Hono API, MCP endpoint apps/mobile Expo + React Native Android app apps/ios Native SwiftUI iOS app (TipTap EditorBundle, GRDB) apps/desktop Electron desktop shell, preload bridge, and native packaging apps/site Astro official website, deployable independently packages/client Shared API client for web and mobile apps packages/shared Shared types, Zod schemas, TipTap / Markdown conversion crates/desktop-sidecar Rust sidecar for local SQLite, offline data, backups, and resources scripts Wrangler wrapper, password hash, CLI, MCP stdio bridge, Evernote ENEX import migrations Shared append-only D1/SQLite database migrations docs Architecture, migration, and deployment docs .github/workflows CI for web, mobile, iOS, desktop packaging, deployment, and releases wrangler.toml Cloudflare Workers, Assets, D1, R2 configuration ```
#### Data Storage Model EdgeEver persists note content simultaneously across three formats to balance editing performance, open portability, and full-text search speed: ```text content_json TipTap/ProseMirror document, the editor source of truth content_markdown API, Agent, export, and external ecosystem interoperability content_text Full-text search, summary generation, and indexing ``` ### Core Mechanisms & Design Decisions - **Client-Side Silent Compression**: To avoid consuming compute quota on serverless runtimes like Cloudflare Workers, image compression occurs in the Web client before upload (converting PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF to WebP when beneficial, max edge 2560px; original retained if compression does not reduce size). REST API and MCP endpoints store client-supplied binaries directly without additional server-side transcoding. - **Offline-First & Sync Timing**: Web and desktop clients automatically upload memo edits after 30 seconds of typing inactivity, and poll for remote changes every 5 minutes while visible; window refocus and manual refresh remain immediate. Configurable via `DEFERRED_MEMO_SYNC_DELAY_MS` and `BACKGROUND_WORKSPACE_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS` in [`apps/web/src/lib/workspace-refresh.ts`](apps/web/src/lib/workspace-refresh.ts). ### Contributing Code Community contributions are warmly welcome! Please keep the following guidelines in mind: - Please review the [Contribution Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) before submitting code. - **Deployment Isolation**: If your GitHub Fork is also used to deploy EdgeEver, keep its `main` branch clean and deployment-only. Create a dedicated branch from official `upstream/main` for features/fixes and pull requests; do not develop on or run Sync fork directly on the deployment `main`. --- ## Community and Feedback - **Issues & Suggestions**: For bugs, feature requests, and deployment questions, please submit to [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/tianma-if/edgeever/issues) to help the community build searchable solutions. ### Telegram Community Welcome to the EdgeEver community, bringing together developers and creators exploring vibe coding and AI. Join us to discuss cutting-edge AI productivity and best practices for personal knowledge bases. 👉 [Join the EdgeEver Telegram group](https://t.me/+GvKYnL37feUwOTNl) ## Friendly Links - [LINUX DO](https://linux.do/) — A community for sharing technology and open-source projects. ## Sponsor & Support EdgeEver is a free and open-source project. Sustaining cross-platform client development, continuous device testing, code signing, and multi-runtime ecosystem maintenance requires ongoing dedication and resources. - [Support EdgeEver](docs/sponsor.md) — Voluntary donation via WeChat Pay or Alipay - [Sponsors & Partners](docs/partners.md) — Support infrastructure, developer tools, services, or community collaboration ## Acknowledgements - EdgeEver's note-taking product design was also informed by the publicly available product experiences of mature note-taking tools such as [Evernote](https://evernote.com/) and [Notion](https://www.notion.com/). The related features were independently designed and implemented by EdgeEver. - The product design of mind-map and visual-diagram notes was informed by the publicly available product experiences of [XMind](https://xmind.com/) and [ProcessOn](https://www.processon.com/). These features were independently designed and implemented by EdgeEver. - EdgeEver's poster design workspace draws inspiration from [Qiaomu Design](https://github.com/joeseesun/qiaomu-cover-design) by 向阳乔木 (joeseesun), and adapts its templates and typography engine under the MIT license. - The visual themes and typography of EdgeEver's image-sharing cards were inspired by [Firefly Card (流光卡片)](https://fireflycard.shushiai.com/). Thank you for the design inspiration. - EdgeEver's one-click WeChat publishing and featured article typography draw inspiration from [gzh-design-skill](https://github.com/isjiamu/gzh-design-skill) by isjiamu. Thank you for the layout and design inspiration. ## Trademark and Brand Use The EdgeEver name, logo, and other brand identifiers distinguish the official project. Forks and modified versions may state that they are based on EdgeEver, but must not imply official status or mislead users. The open-source license does not grant trademark rights; other uses require prior written permission from the project maintainers. ## Disclaimer EdgeEver is an independent open-source note-taking application developed and maintained by individuals and the community. It is not affiliated with, authorized, sponsored, or endorsed by Evernote Corporation or its affiliates. EdgeEver is self-hosted software. Except for official demo instances, project maintainers do not host, control, or review user content. Content stored or displayed by an instance is the responsibility of its users or operators and does not represent the maintainers' views. ## Contributors

EdgeEver 是一款现代化的开源笔记与个人知识库工作区。它保留经典高效的三栏工作区体验（目录树 · 笔记列表 · 编辑写作），同时具备完全开放的数据架构与原生 AI Agent 联动能力，让个人知识沉淀更轻量、更自由。 > 💡 **终身免服务器，100% 免费** > EdgeEver 可以免费运行在 Cloudflare 配额内，无需购买或维护服务器；希望使用 VPS、NAS 或家庭服务器的用户，也可以通过 Docker 部署同一套应用。 > ⭐ 如果 EdgeEver 对你有帮助，欢迎点个 Star。你的支持会帮助更多人发现这个项目。 ## 为什么做 EdgeEver 很多**笔记与个人知识库**的用户，核心需求只是一个**可靠、开放、响应迅速**的个人知识库。然而，当下的主流方案都各有痛点： * **印象笔记**：拥有最无感、最丝滑的多端云同步体验。然而随着它演进为全功能商业套件，广告与附加功能渐多，系统开销也随之走高；加之免费版配额收紧、高级 AI 订阅昂贵，且难以灵活接入现代自托管与私有 AI 工作流。 * **Obsidian**：Markdown 开放，核心闭源；官方同步按容量与库数量持续订阅收费，第三方同步（iCloud / WebDAV / Git 等）繁琐且易冲突，受限于纯本地文件目录的同步机制与移动端后台限制，难以像云原生笔记那样丝滑无感同步（且缺少完整 Web 端）；依赖本地遍历扫描，笔记上千或插件增多后冷启动与检索明显卡顿；附件混存易膨胀、拖慢移动同步且删后难清理；加之类似 IDE 的交互与插件折腾生态上手门槛较高，对于习惯传统云笔记“开箱即用、随时随地随手记”的用户来说明显偏重。 * **Joplin**：老牌开源三栏笔记，但界面观感与编辑交互仿佛还停留在十几年前，缺乏现代软件的精致与流畅感；官方高速同步（Joplin Cloud）需付费订阅，免费同步若走 WebDAV 或网盘，受限于逐文件轮询，笔记与附件增多后（尤其在移动端）同步缓慢，而自建 Joplin Server 又必须自备服务器维护，缺少零成本 Serverless 方案；此外它没有可在浏览器即开即用的完整 Web 工作区，也缺乏原生 AI Agent（MCP/ACP）与多模态知识形态。 * **Memos / Flomo 等轻量笔记**：虽然简单好用，但流式卡片布局与习惯了经典“三栏工作流”的用户有着天然的交互习惯差异。 * **思源笔记等块级知识库**：功能深厚且支持开源自托管，但 UI 交互更贴近 Obsidian 式的重度知识库而非传统商业云笔记的直觉三栏体验，全面的“块级（Block）”架构也使得日常随手记录与连续排版书写的心智负担偏重；且缺少零服务器成本的 Serverless 部署形态，多端同步主要依赖官方付费订阅，或需额外付费解锁 S3/WebDAV 同步特性并自备存储。 **EdgeEver 恰好填补了这一空白**：整栈开源，提供真正**零感知、低延迟的多端瞬时云同步**，且全部服务均可免费自托管；同时保留经典三栏布局与流畅排版，万条笔记常驻依然轻盈丝滑，原生支持接入 AI Agent，部署维护零门槛、零费用。 ## 在线演示 - Demo 地址：[https://demo.edgeever.org](https://demo.edgeever.org) 公开演示环境会在每天凌晨 3:00（北京时间）自动重置并恢复示例笔记，请不要保存私密内容。 ## 全平台客户端与浏览器插件 ### 客户端下载

Fork https://github.com/tianma-if/edgeever。 2. 在 Cloudflare 中创建 D1 `edgeever` 与 R2 `edgeever-resources`。 3. 在 Workers & Pages 中选择「Start with Hello World!」，创建名为 `edgeever` 的 Worker。 4. 在该 Worker 的 Settings → Variables and Secrets 中添加运行时 Secret `EDGE_EVER_AUTH_PASSWORD`，值为用户指定的登录密码（建议至少 32 个字符），并点击 Deploy。 管理员用户名默认为 `admin`。 5. 确认 Secret 已部署后，在该 Worker 的 Settings → Builds → Connect 中连接 Fork 的 `main` 分支。 6. 在该 Worker 的 Settings → Builds → API token 中选择或创建用于部署的 Cloudflare API Token，并确保它具备目标账户的 D1 读取和编辑权限。 7. 在 Fork 的 GitHub 仓库中进入 Actions → Update deployed EdgeEver，按提示启用工作流， 选择 `main` 分支并点击 Run workflow。在 Cloudflare 确认对应构建成功、部署完成后，验证 `/api/health` 和 `/api/openapi.json`， 再用管理员用户名和密码验证登录。 后续由该工作流自动同步正式版本，持续获得功能更新和问题修复。 ``` > 详细约定与要求请查看：[AI Agent 在线部署约定](docs/agent-deploy-cloudflare.zh-CN.md)。 ### 方案二：手动在线部署
📖 展开查看：网页端 7 步手动部署流程 请严格按以下顺序，在网页端完成 7 步配置： 1. **Fork 仓库**：在 GitHub 点击右上角 **Fork**，将项目 Fork 到您的个人账户下。 2. **创建 Cloudflare 资源**：创建 D1 `edgeever` 与 R2 `edgeever-resources`。 3. **创建 Worker**：在 Cloudflare Workers & Pages 中选择 Create application → Start with Hello World!，命名为 `edgeever` 并部署。此时是占位服务，第 7 步才部署 EdgeEver。 4. **设置管理员密码**：在该 Worker 的 Settings → Variables and Secrets 中，选择 Secret 类型，添加 `EDGE_EVER_AUTH_PASSWORD` 并点击 Deploy。值为您指定的登录密码，建议至少 32 个字符。完成后再连接 Fork。 5. **连接 Fork**：在已有 Worker 的 Settings → Builds → Connect 中选择 Fork 和生产分支 `main`。 6. **配置部署权限**：在该 Worker 的 Settings → Builds → API token 中选择或创建用于部署的 Cloudflare API Token，并确保它具备目标账户的 D1 读取和编辑权限。 7. **构建并验证**：在 Fork 的 GitHub 仓库中进入 Actions → Update deployed EdgeEver，按提示启用工作流， 选择 `main` 分支并点击 Run workflow。在 Cloudflare 确认对应构建成功、部署完成后，确认 `/api/health` 返回 `200`，并验证登录。后续由该工作流自动同步正式版本，持续获得功能更新和问题修复。 > 📖 包含具体参数与构建命令的详细步骤，请查看 [在线部署完整文档](docs/deploy-cloudflare-button.zh-CN.md)。

### 方案三：在 VPS 或 NAS 上使用 Docker Docker 与 Cloudflare 共用同一套前端、API 路由、业务服务、鉴权、MCP 实现和 migration。容器使用 SQLite，并支持本地文件或 S3 兼容附件存储，提供 `amd64` 与 `arm64` 镜像。详见[使用 Docker 部署 EdgeEver](docs/deploy-docker.zh-CN.md)和[自托管与 Docker 架构](docs/self-hosting-architecture.zh-CN.md)。 使用 GitHub 托管的安装脚本和官方 GHCR 镜像： ```sh curl -fsSL https://edgeever.org/install.sh | bash ``` 该命令会自动拉取最新镜像、生成管理员密码，并使用 Docker Compose 启动 EdgeEver。手动部署与配置说明见 [Docker 部署文档](docs/deploy-docker.zh-CN.md)。 安装后默认每日自动更新。如需手动更新，请在部署服务器上运行 `~/edgeever/update.sh`。 > 💡 **网络提示**：官方镜像托管于 GitHub（GHCR）。若在部分网络环境下遇到拉取缓慢或超时，请在部署前自行配置可用的网络代理或可信的镜像加速服务。 --- ## 进阶配置与管理 ### 数据导入导出与备份 无论是日常数据备份、跨实例无缝迁移，还是从已有笔记平台迁入，EdgeEver 均提供完整可靠的数据流转方案： - **EdgeEver 原生备份与还原**：在应用内进入 **个人中心** -> **导入与导出**，可随时导出或导入 EdgeEver ZIP 档案包。解压后的 `notes/` 目录保留清晰的纯文本 Markdown 文件与附件，可直接用于本地归档或独立阅读；内部结构化元数据则支持在不同 EdgeEver 实例间无损全量还原。导入时保留目标实例的既有数据，同 ID 内容自动覆盖更新。 - **桌面端定时自动备份与异地副本**：在桌面客户端的 **备份与导入** 设置中支持开启本地定时自动备份，可自定义备份目录、周期（每周 / 每月）与快照保留份数，内容有变更时自动生成标准 ZIP 或 `.edgeever.enc` 加密归档；同时支持配置 WebDAV 异地副本，每次本地备份完成后自动上传至 NAS 或兼容存储。 - **第三方笔记平滑迁入**：无论是通过 Web/桌面端图形界面原生一键导入（支持印象笔记/Evernote、Obsidian、Joplin 的完整笔记、层级与附件），还是借助 AI Agent (MCP) 协同迁入 Notion、flomo、Memos 等知识库，EdgeEver 均提供无缝、可验证的迁移能力。详见 [第三方笔记平滑迁入 EdgeEver 完整指南](docs/note-migration-guide.md)。 ### AI 与 MCP 协议互联 在 **个人中心** -> **API / MCP** 中创建 API Token 并一键复制 Remote MCP 配置，即可让 Claude Code、Codex、DeepSeek Harness、Antigravity 等 AI Agent 在账号授权范围内安全管理你的知识库。系统支持文本笔记、图表笔记（思维导图、流程图与架构图）、多维表格笔记与原生海报笔记的完整增删改查，Agent 还可管理笔记本目录、标签、附件、历史版本、笔记模板与 AI 指令。 客户端配置、Token 权限、问题排查和 Agent 工作规则示例，请参阅 [在 MCP 客户端与 AI Agent 中使用 EdgeEver](docs/mcp-guide.zh-CN.md)。 > 💡 **场景启发：** > 让 AI 真正成为你的知识管家与创作外脑——不仅能将方案秒级生成为可交互的思维导图、流程图、架构图与多维表格，还能为 AI Agent 提供私有知识上下文。依托 EdgeEver 强大的富文本编辑与精美排版能力，AI 协同沉淀的不再是冰冷文本，而是结构工整、排版优雅、随时可一键分发的高品质知识资产。 ### 多账号登录与存储管理 部署完成后，单个实例支持多账号登录。 实例管理员可以在 **个人中心** -> **账号管理** 中创建、停用成员账号或重置密码。每个成员拥有完全隔离的个人空间，包括笔记本、笔记、附件、回收站、导入导出和 MCP Token 等。系统同时提供直观的存储用量面板，可实时掌握实例整体与各账号的附件存储占用明细。 ### 存储扩展与第三方图床 - **OSS 对象存储**：实例 Owner 可在**设置 → 高级设置 → OSS 对象存储**中配置兼容 S3 API 的对象存储。切换存储不会迁移或影响已有附件。 - **桌面端 PicGo 图床**：桌面端可以把新插入的图片交给本机或你信任的远程 PicGo、PicList 服务（例如 NAS），再由它上传到 GitHub、SM.MS、又拍云、七牛云或自建图床。地址只需以 `/upload` 结尾，经过反向代理的 PicList 也能使用。 - **桌面端与网页端 CloudFlare ImgBed**：使用 API Token 将新插入的图片直接上传到自建 [CloudFlare ImgBed](https://github.com/MarSeventh/CloudFlare-ImgBed)，目录支持 `{Y}/{m}/{d}`、`{memoId}` 等占位符。网页端要求 HTTPS，并在图床跨域配置中允许当前 EdgeEver 来源和 `Authorization` 请求头。凭据仅保存在当前浏览器或桌面端，图片不纳入 EdgeEver 备份。 ### 插件与个性化主题 Web 与桌面端支持功能插件与个性化主题，可从官方市场、GitHub 或 Manifest 地址一键安装，并随工作区跨端同步。开发者可使用 `@edgeever/plugin-api` 扩展能力，详见[插件开发文档](docs/plugin-development.zh-CN.md)与[官方插件市场上架政策](docs/plugin-marketplace-policy.zh-CN.md)。 --- ## 开发者指南与贡献 ### 快速开始 ```sh bun install bun run dev ``` 本地开发默认自动登录，首次账号为 `owner` / `edgeever-local-dev`；测试登录页可主动退出登录。 ### 架构设计与技术栈 #### 技术栈选型 - Bun workspace monorepo，包含 Web、API、官网与共享类型包。 - 前端：Vite、React、React Router、TanStack Query，UI 基于 Tailwind CSS、shadcn/ui、Radix UI。 - 编辑器：TipTap / ProseMirror，支持 Markdown。 - Android App：`apps/mobile` 中的 Expo + React Native，采用 SQLite 本地存储与增量同步。 - iOS App：`apps/ios` 中的原生 SwiftUI（iOS 17+），内置 TipTap EditorBundle、GRDB 本地镜像/outbox，界面与 Android 壳层对齐。 - 原生桌面端：Electron + Rust sidecar，兼顾跨平台一致体验与高性能本地数据服务；基于 SQLite 支持离线编辑、联网后增量同步与本地备份。 - 网页裁剪：Manifest V3、Mozilla Readability、Turndown，支持 Chrome、Microsoft Edge 与 Firefox。 - 后端：一套基于 Hono/Zod 的业务应用，提供 REST API 与 Remote MCP；Cloudflare 使用 Workers/D1/R2，Docker 使用 Bun/SQLite/本地文件或 S3。 - 官网：Astro 静态站点，位于 `apps/site`，可独立构建并部署到 Cloudflare Pages。 #### 目录结构
📁 展开查看：Monorepo 项目目录结构 ```text apps/web Vite + React 前端、离线草稿与同步队列 apps/extension Chrome/Edge/Firefox Manifest V3 网页裁剪插件 apps/api Cloudflare Worker + Hono API、MCP endpoint apps/mobile Expo + React Native Android App apps/ios 原生 SwiftUI iOS App（TipTap EditorBundle、GRDB） apps/desktop Electron 桌面端壳层、preload bridge 与原生打包配置 apps/site Astro 官方网站，可独立部署 packages/client Web 与移动端共享的 API Client packages/shared 共享类型、Zod schema、TipTap / Markdown 内容转换 crates/desktop-sidecar Rust sidecar，负责本地 SQLite、离线数据、备份与资源服务 scripts Wrangler 封装、密码 hash、CLI、MCP stdio bridge、Evernote ENEX 导入 migrations D1/SQLite 共用、只增不改的数据库 migration docs 架构、迁移与部署文档 .github/workflows Web、移动端、iOS、桌面端打包、部署与 Release 的 CI wrangler.toml Cloudflare Workers、Assets、D1、R2 配置 ```
#### 数据存储模型 EdgeEver 在数据库中同时保存三种内容形态，以兼顾编辑性能、开放性与全库检索效率： ```text content_json TipTap/ProseMirror 文档，编辑器权威格式 content_markdown API、Agent、导入导出与外部生态消费格式 content_text 全文搜索、摘要与快速索引使用 ``` ### 核心机制与设计决策 - **端侧静默压缩**：为避免在 Serverless（如 Cloudflare Worker）上执行图片转码消耗宝贵的计算额度，图片压缩全部放在 Web 客户端上传前完成（PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF 转 WebP，最大边限制 2560px；不减小体积则保留原图）。服务端 REST API 与 MCP 接口直接入库客户端传输的原始内容。 - **离线优先与同步时序**：Web 与桌面端会在用户停止编辑 30 秒后自动上传增量，并在前台页面可见时每 5 分钟拉取一次云端变更；窗口重聚焦或手动刷新时立即同步。开发者可在 [`apps/web/src/lib/workspace-refresh.ts`](apps/web/src/lib/workspace-refresh.ts) 中调整相关时序常量（`DEFERRED_MEMO_SYNC_DELAY_MS` 与 `BACKGROUND_WORKSPACE_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS`）。 ### 参与代码贡献 我们非常欢迎社区贡献！贡献前请留意以下约定： - 提交代码前请仔细阅读 [贡献代码须知](CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md)。 - **分支与部署隔离**：如果您的 GitHub Fork 同时用于在线部署 EdgeEver，请将 `main` 分支严格保留为只读部署分支；请从官方 `upstream/main` 创建新分支进行功能开发并提交 Pull Request，严禁在部署用的 `main` 分支上直接修改代码或执行 Sync fork。 --- ## 社区与反馈 - **问题反馈与功能建议**：遇到 Bug、功能建议或部署疑问，请优先提交 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/tianma-if/edgeever/issues)，方便社区沉淀并检索解决方案。
